auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the mobile number or email your admin set up for you.
auth.chooseCompanyHint: Your login works in more than one company.
auth.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask your admin to reset it.
auth.heroTitle: Every piece of work has an owner, a time and a verifier.
auth.heroBody: Tasks, checklists, processes, attendance, stock and sales: set up once, run every day.
auth.heroPoint2: Works on any phone, in Hindi and English
auth.heroPoint3: Nothing is lost: every change is recorded
auth.newPasswordHint: At least 8 characters with a letter and a number.
auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
auth.firstLoginBody: You signed in with a one-time password. Pick a new one to continue; only you will know it.

company.gstOffline: Checksum is correct. No GST lookup is connected, so type the legal name yourself.

gstBad.state: The first two digits are not a state code
gstBad.checksum: The last character doesn't match: check for a typo

company.contactsHint: Add as many as you need.

shifts.emptyBody: Shifts decide working hours for attendance, reminders and due times.

branches.emptyBody: Plants, mines, offices and warehouses. Put one under another to build the tree.

designations.placeholder: Type a designation and press Enter
designations.hint: A designation can be deleted only when nobody has it.

departments.typeEnter: Type a department and press Enter, then the next one
departments.dragHint: Drag a card onto another to make it a sub-department.
departments.emptyBody: Type the first one above and press Enter.
departments.deleteBody: A department can be deleted only when it has no people and no sub-departments.
departments.subTitle: Sub-department
departments.addFromParent: Add people from the parent department

users.pasteHint: Copy rows from Excel or Google Sheets and paste them here: name, mobile, email, department, designation. A header row in any order also works.
users.giveLogin: Give app login now (a one-time password is shown once)
users.bulkSkipped_one: {{count}} person has no mobile or email, so no login
users.bulkSkipped_other: {{count}} people have no mobile or email, so no login
users.emptyBody: Add people one by one or paste a list from Excel.
users.deleteBody: They are marked as left and can't log in. Their history stays.
users.tempBody: Share this with the person. It is shown only now; they must choose their own password at first login.

roles.inUse: Give these people another role first
roles.matrixHint: Tick what this role can do in each module.
roles.ownerAll: The Owner can always do everything.
roles.processBody: Given per process in the FMS builder (phase 5), on top of the main role.

chart.hint: Drag a person onto another department, or onto the top slot to make them HOD. On phones, press and hold to drag.
chart.noHod: No HOD yet — drop a person here
chart.personLabel: {{name}}: drag to move, tap for details
chart.openWorkSoon: Tasks, checklists and process steps show here from phase 3.

look.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Square works best.
look.staffAccent: Staff may pick their own accent colour
look.staffAccentHint: Status colours always stay the same.

notify.secretSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
notify.secretOnce: Stored encrypted. It won't be shown again.
notify.driveSoon: Connecting your own Google Drive for uploads arrives in phase 10. Until then files stay on the MONO server and are included in the nightly backup.

wa.switchWarning: Switching provider resets the connection. Enter the new provider's API key.

ch.emailHint: Any SMTP server: Gmail (app password), Zoho, your hosting.
ch.envDefault: Using the server's default from .env until you save your own.
ch.telegramHint: Create a bot with @BotFather on Telegram and paste its token here.
ch.pushHint: Lets the installed app show notifications on phones and computers.
ch.keysMade: Keys created. Everyone turns phone notifications on again.

tpl.narrow_one: Showing 300 of {{count}}. Search or filter to narrow it down.
tpl.narrow_other: Showing 300 of {{count}}. Search or filter to narrow it down.
tpl.subject: Email subject
tpl.tgHint: Telegram: bold works. Tap a variable below to add it.
tpl.waHint: WhatsApp: *bold* works. Variables are numbered 1, 2, 3 … when you submit the template.

tg.sendAll_other: Send codes to all {{count}} not linked
tg.shownBody: These people have no mobile or email, so their codes could not be sent.
tg.how1: Get the 8-character code (sent by WhatsApp/email, or Profile → Link my Telegram).
tg.how3: Send the code. Done: tasks and reminders arrive there.
tg.groupHint: Add {{bot}} to a Telegram group, then paste the group's chat ID. Every notification is copied there.
tg.noBotBody: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token in Connect channels. Then people can link their Telegram here.

my.title: Link my Telegram
my.why: Get your tasks and reminders on Telegram, with buttons to answer from there.
my.send: Send this code to {{bot}}, or tap the button.
my.expires: The code works for 24 hours. This card updates when you're linked.

push.title: Phone notifications
push.noKeys: Your admin hasn't set up phone notifications yet.
push.on: Notifications are on for this device

state.unsupported: Open MONO from your home screen (installed app) to use phone notifications.
state.off: Get a notification on this device when something needs you.
state.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser settings.

rule.escalateBoth: Pick both who to escalate to and after how many minutes.
rule.replyMeans: A reply means the person opened the notification, tapped "Seen" in Telegram, or did anything on the same record.
rule.testHint: Sends a real test event through the rules: in-app, Telegram, email, WhatsApp and phone, whichever are set up.
rule.testSent: Test sent. It arrives in a few seconds.

rem.hint: Tasks and checklists pick one of these to decide when to remind.

inbox.emptyBody: Messages about your work show up here as soon as they happen.

files.hint: or drop files here, or paste a screenshot (Ctrl+V)

ws.emptyBody: New tasks and checklists show up here the moment they are given to you.

reassign.title: Give the task to someone else

kpi.notDone: All work should be done (% not done)
kpi.notOnTime: All work should be done on time (% not on time)
kpi.verifyPending: All verifications should be done (% not done)
kpi.verifyLate: Verifications within the target time (% late)

rep.rygLegend: Green = on time, never moved. Yellow = a day late or moved once. Red = two or more days late, or moved twice or more. Open = still running and not late.

task.descriptionPh: What needs to be done, by when, and what 'done' looks like
task.requireProof: Require a photo or file when this is marked done: the doer cannot close it on a remark alone
task.submitHint: The doer gets it on Telegram
task.fmsSoon: Steps from processes (FMS) appear here with phase 5.
task.importHint: Paste rows or open a CSV/Excel file. Columns: doer, planned date (DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm), task, verifier, proof (yes/no).

chk.noRunsBody: Runs appear here when they are due.

slip.title: Help slip #{{n}}

dlg.return: Send it back to the raiser

slip.emptyBody: A help slip is a problem plus your own ideas to solve it. The approver picks one and it becomes a task.
slip.problemHint: What is wrong, where, and how it affects work.
slip.problemShort: Describe the problem in a few more words
slip.submitHint: The receiver screens it first, then the approver decides.
slip.approveHint: Approving creates a delegation task for this person, linked to the slip.

ticket.emptyBody: Raise a ticket when something is broken and someone needs to fix it.
ticket.whatPh: e.g. Printer on floor 2 jams on A3
ticket.submitHint: The solver gets it on Telegram. Late tickets escalate on their own.
ticket.titleShort: Say what is wrong in a few words
ticket.proof: Photo or file that shows it is fixed

stageHint.INFORMATION: Reference only; closes on its own
stageHint.SOMEDAY: Maybe later; reviewed now and then
stageHint.SCHEDULED: Has a day and a time

ea.capturePh: One line — a call, an idea, a promise…
ea.waitingOnPh: Who or what are we waiting for?
ea.bookSlotHint: Pick an item to put in this slot.
ea.nothingToBook: Nothing to schedule. Capture something first.

mis.legend: % of what was due that week (up to now for this week). Green 90%+, amber 70%+, red below. FMS steps arrive with processes. Sent every Monday at 09:00 to the owner and HODs.

engine.lifeHint: From the moment it is given to the moment it closes. Switched-off steps fade out.
engine.saved: Saved. The flow works this way from now on.
engine.noChanges: No changes yet — the default flow is in use.
engine.rolesLegend: Who hears about what on Telegram

h.eaUserId: Verifies tasks when "EA verifies" is on, and sorts the EA board.
h.verifierUserId: Checks runs when a checklist has no verifier of its own.
h.receiverUserId: Screens new slips. Empty: the raiser's HOD.
h.coordinatorUserId: Rides along on every ticket and gets level-1 escalations. Empty: the solver's HOD.
h.doerMustAccept: New tasks wait until the doer accepts them.
h.eaVerifies: Off: Mark done goes straight to Done (unless a task has its own verifier).
h.allowReopen: Verifiers can send work back and creators can reopen done tasks.
h.verifierStep: Submitted checklists wait for the verifier.
h.photoVoiceProof: Items marked "photo" or "voice" need the file before they tick.
h.tellOwnerAboutMisses: The owner hears about every missed checklist.
h.receiverScreens: Off: new slips go straight to the approver.
h.proofToResolve: The solver must attach a photo or file to mark it fixed.
h.informationStage: Reference items get their own column.
h.waitingStage: Parked items get their own column (with the cap).
h.missedDayToSomeday: Scheduled items whose day passed go back to Someday.
